壱Chapter 01 · Hand-Sign Dojo

Weave the signs. Cast the jutsu.

Twelve hand signs, one for each animal of the zodiac. Tap them in the right order and the Sage casts it right inside the panel: a Great Fireball, a crackling Chidori, a line of shadow clones, a summoned toad. Stuck? Tap a jutsu in the scroll and he shows you the signs.

  • Six jutsu, each with its own animated effect
  • Sensei hints light up the signs that can come next
  • A wrong sign fizzles and shakes the panel
  • Every jutsu you cast is ticked off in the scroll

弐Chapter 02 · Chakra Nature Test

Which chakra nature runs in you?

Ninja test their chakra on a slip of special paper. Type your name, press and hold to pour chakra in, and watch the paper react: it burns for Fire, splits for Wind, crumples for Lightning, crumbles for Earth and soaks for Water. The same name always gets the same nature.

  • Press-and-hold charging with a chakra meter
  • Five different paper reactions, drawn in ink
  • Your strengths, weaknesses and signature jutsu
  • Works with a mouse, a finger or the keyboard

Pick a page layout, then tap a panel to fill it: choose a character, a screen tone, a line for the speech bubble and a sound effect. Hit Random story for a ready-made gag, or switch to Read mode to see your page clean. Your page is kept in this browser for next time.

相談 Day 0

The talk

You tell me what the business needs, in a call or a chat. I ask the boring questions early: who uses it, how you get paid, what must never break.

You get a one-page plan and a fixed price within 24 hours.

設計 Days 1–3

The sketch

Wireframes first, then the real design in your colours. You click through it on your own phone before a single line of production code exists.

You get a clickable design, with one round of changes included.

制作 Days 3–10

The build

The heavy lifting. Clean code, fast pages, and the payments, bots and admin wired in. A private preview link updates as the work lands.

You get daily progress you can open on any device.

試験 The checkup

Every page, examined

Tested on cheap phones, slow 4G and three browsers. Forms, payments and emails are tried end to end, with real money set to zero.

You get a checklist with every test ticked.

公開 Launch day

The lantern goes up

Domain, hosting, HTTPS, Search Console and analytics set up. The switch happens at a quiet hour, and the old site is kept as a backup.

You get your site live, plus a short video on running it.

見守り After launch

Looked after

Bugs found in the first 30 days are fixed free. After that, light monthly care keeps everything updated, backed up and quick.

You get 30 days of free fixes and weekly backups.
